verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led legal services, not a software or automation platform, so user-scheduled recurring jobs or workflows are outside its product category. Its client portal is documented only for document sharing, messaging, and case-status tracking. Its attorney-performed expiration tracking is a legal service, not a schedulable recurring-job capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
